# CNBC

> > CNBC is a global business news network providing comprehensive coverage of financial markets, economic policy, central banking, and business trends.

CNBC delivers real-time news and analysis on the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, Bank of England, and other major central banks, along with in-depth reporting on monetary policy, interest rates, inflation, and economic developments across the United States, Europe, Middle East, and Asia. The network features expert journalists including Jeff Cox, Jessica Dickler, and Holly Ellyatt covering economics, personal finance, and international markets.

## Key Topics

- Federal Reserve
- European Central Bank (ECB)
- Bank of England
- People's Bank of China
- Interest rates
- Monetary policy
- Central banking
- Inflation
- Rate cuts
- Christine Lagarde
- Fed Governor Miran
- Euro currency
- European economy
- Middle East economics
- Business competitiveness

## Central Banking & Monetary Policy

- [News from Central Banks](https://www.cnbc.com/central-banks/): Latest news on Federal Reserve, ECB, Bank of England & central banks
- [European Central Bank](https://www.cnbc.com/european-central-bank/): ECB news coverage featuring Christine Lagarde & monetary policy updates
- [People's Bank of China](https://www.cnbc.com/peoples-bank-of-china/): People's Bank of China news on yuan, bonds & monetary policy

## Business & Economic Analysis

- [America's Top States for Business](https://www.cnbc.com/americas-top-states-for-business/): Annual state rankings on 135 metrics across 10 competitiveness categories
